name: Ethiopia
dated: VAT Proclamation No. 1341/2024 (Federal Negarit Gazette No. 61, 21 August 2024); tax year EFY 2017 (8 July 2024 - 7 July 2025) holds most of 2025
sources: Sources: VAT Proclamation No. 1341/2024 (registry fetch `global/registry/afm_data/fetch/ET/et_vat_1341.pdf.txt`); Income Tax (Amendment) Proclamation No. 1395/2025 (`world/B10-anglophone-africa/et/law/mor_proc_1395.txt`, in force 8 July 2025); Income Tax Proclamation No. 979/2016 (`mor_proc_979.txt`: the extraction keeps the tables but not the provisions' wording). Pass 9 (CIT/WHT): Federal Income Tax Proclamation No. 979/2016 (Negarit Gazette 22nd year No. 104, `world/B10-anglophone-africa/et/law/mor_proc_979.txt`) read in its Amharic text (the English column is not in the extraction; the Amharic is clean UTF-8): art. 19 (1) and art. 51 (2). Proclamation 1395/2025 (`mor_proc_1395.txt`, Negarit Gazette 31st year No. 64, 1 September 2025) replaces the non-resident rates from EFY 2018 (8 July 2025) and adds an alternative minimum tax; Proclamation 1157/2019 not read (flagged). Pass 10 (excise): the Ministry of Revenues' full scans of the Excise Tax Proclamation No. 1186/2020 (88 pages) and the Excise Tax (Amendment) Proclamation No. 1287/2023 (18 pages, with the replacing First Schedule) via Wayback (`mor.gov.et/documents/49818/172546/Excise+Tax+Proclamation+1186-2012.pdf/…`, `mor.gov.et/documents/49818/0/1287-2015+…pdf/…`), in `R4/fetch/et10/` (OCR eng; the schedule was read on the page images, pp. 9-11 of 1287). The earlier copies in `R4/fetch/et9/` lacked the schedule pages. Pass 10 (excise): the Ministry of Revenues' full scans of the Excise Tax Proclamation No. 1186/2020 (88 pages) and the Excise Tax (Amendment) Proclamation No. 1287/2023 (18 pages, with the replacing First Schedule) via Wayback (`mor.gov.et/documents/49818/172546/Excise+Tax+Proclamation+1186-2012.pdf/…`, `mor.gov.et/documents/49818/0/1287-2015+…pdf/…`), in `R4/fetch/et10/` (OCR eng; the schedule was read on the page images, pp. 9-11 of 1287). The earlier copies in `R4/fetch/et9/` lacked the schedule pages.

vat.name: Value Added Tax
vat.statute: VAT Proclamation No. 1341/2024 art. 7 (2) b) (15 %) [text version: Proclamation No. 1341/2024 as published (Federal Negarit Gazette No. 61, 21 August 2024)]
vat.doc: Proclamation 1341/2024: the VAT rate "b) in any other case 15 percent" (zero rate for the listed zero-rated supplies). The exempt-supply list was not resolved in the bilingual extraction: every basket line at 15 %.
notes: VAT Proclamation 1341/2024: exempt supplies (financial services, residential rent, education, medical services …) not resolved in the bilingual extraction: every line at 15 %

excise.name: Excise tax
excise.statute: Excise Tax Proclamation No. 1186/2020 as amended by the Excise Tax (Amendment) Proclamation No. 1287/2023 (charging provision as replaced: "Excise Tax shall be charged at the rate specified in the First Schedule attached"), First Schedule: beer 40 % or 11 Birr per litre whichever is higher; wine (local content below 75 %) 40 %; spirits 80 %; sweetened waters 25 %; cigarettes 30 % + 8 Birr per pack of 20; kerosene, benzene and diesel oils 15 % [text version: Proclamation No. 1186/2020 as amended by Proclamation No. 1287/2023 (Federal Negarit Gazette, 2023); no later amendment in the Ministry of Revenues' archived list (flag)]
excise.doc: Proclamation No. 1287/2023, First Schedule (Tariff Number / Description / Excise Rate): "2202.1000 Waters, including mineral waters and aerated waters, containing added sugar or other sweetening matter or flavoured 25%"; "2203.0000 Beer made from malt 40% or 11 Birr per liter, whichever is higher" (beer produced exclusively from barley grown and malted in Ethiopia 35 % or 9 Birr; local raw material content at least 75 % 30 % or 8 Birr); "2204.10 to 2205.90 Wine the local raw material content of which excluding water is at less than 75% by weight of its constituents 40%"; "2208.20 to 2208.70 Spirits obtained by distilling grape wine or grape marc, Whiskies, Rum ..., Gin and Geneva, Vodka, and Liqueurs and cordials 80%"; "2402.2000 Cigarettes containing tobacco 30% + 8 Birr per pack (20 stick)"; "Chapter 27 Kerosene, Benzene and Diesel Oils 15%". Proclamation 1287/2023, replaced charging provision (sub-article 2): "Excise Tax shall be charged at the rate specified in the first Schedule attached".

items.name: Excise tax (beer made from malt, 2203.0000)
items.statute: Proc. 1287/2023 First Schedule 2203.0000: 40 % or 11 Birr per litre, whichever is higher

items.name: Excise tax (cigarettes, 2402.2000)
items.statute: Proc. 1287/2023 First Schedule 2402.2000: 30 % + 8 Birr per pack of 20 (0.40 Birr per cigarette)

items.name: Excise tax (benzene)
items.statute: Proc. 1287/2023 First Schedule chapter 27: kerosene, benzene and diesel oils 15 %

items.name: Excise tax (diesel oils)
items.statute: Proc. 1287/2023 First Schedule chapter 27: kerosene, benzene and diesel oils 15 %

notes: the excise base is the cost of production (local goods) or the customs value plus duties (imports), approximated by the region convention (value before excise and VAT)
beer from Ethiopian barley (35 % / 9 Birr) and with at least 75 % local content (30 % / 8 Birr), and wine with at least 75 % local content (30 %), are not separated
no amendment after Proclamation 1287/2023 is in the Ministry of Revenues' archived document list (flagged); whether fuel sold at regulated prices bears VAT is not established
unsupported: amendments after 1287/2023 not searched beyond the MoR list

cit.name: Business income tax (bodies)
cit.statute: Federal Income Tax Proclamation No. 979/2016 art. 19 (1) (business income tax rate for bodies 30 %); unchanged by Proclamation 1395/2025
cit.doc: Proc. 979/2016 art. 19 (Amharic text): (numbered '09.' in the extraction, Ethiopic tens lost) "በንግድ ሥራ ገቢ ላይ ተፈፃሚ የሚሆኑ መጣኔዎች 1/ በድርጅት ላይ ተፈፃሚ የሚሆነው የንግድ ሥራ ገቢ የግብር መጣኔ ሰላሳ በመቶ (፴%) ነው፡፡" (the business income tax rate applicable to a body is thirty percent).
notes: the alternative minimum tax of Proclamation 1395/2025 (EFY 2018, from 8 July 2025) is not modelled; Proclamation 1157/2019 (amendment) not read (flagged); the Ethiopian fiscal year runs 8 July-7 July

wht.name: Income tax on non-residents' Ethiopian-source payments (Schedule D)
wht.statute: Federal Income Tax Proclamation No. 979/2016 art. 51 (2) (a) insurance premium or royalty 5 %, (b) dividend or interest 10 %, (c) management or technical service fee 15 %, to 6 August 2025; Proclamation No. 1395/2025 art. 52 (2) as replaced (a) insurance premium 15 %, royalty 10 %, (b) dividend 15 %, (c) interest 10 %, (d) management or technical fee 15 %, for Schedule D tax collected from 7 August 2025 (art. 4 (2)) [text version: Proclamation No. 979/2016 as published (Federal Negarit Gazette, 2016); Proclamation No. 1395/2025 as published (Federal Negarit Gazette No. 64, 1 September 2025; world/B10-anglophone-africa/et/law/mor_proc_1395.txt, English column of art. 4 and of art. 52 (2)). Split by the payment's date (twentieth pass); pass 19's '8 July' was the date of art. 4 (3), which does not govern Schedule D]
wht.doc: Proc. 979/2016 art. 51 (Amharic text): "1/ በኢትዮጵያ ነዋሪ ያልሆነ ሰው የትርፍ ድርሻ፣ ወለድ፣ ሮያሊቲ፣ የሥራ አመራር ክፍያ፣ የቴክኒክ አገልግሎት ክፍያ ወይም የመድን አረቦን ከኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ ያገኘ እንደሆነ በዚህ አንቀጽ ንዑስ አንቀጽ (2) በተመለከተው መጣኔ መሠረት ግብር የመክፈል ግዴታ አለበት፡፡ 2/ በኢትዮጵያ ነዋሪ ያልሆነ ሰው ግብር የሚከፍልበት መጣኔ፡- ሀ) ለመድህን በሚከፈል አረቦን ወይም ከሮያሊቲ ጠቅላላው ክፍያ ላይ 5% (አምስት በመቶ)፤ ለ) ከትርፍ ድርሻ ወይም ከወለድ፣ ጠቅላላ ገቢ ላይ 10% (አስር በመቶ)፤ ሐ) ከስራ አመራር ክፍያ ወይም ከቴክኒክ አገልግሎት ክፍያ ከጠቅላላ ገቢው ላይ 15% (አሥራ አምስት በመቶ)" (the extraction prints the Ethiopic-numeral tens as '0%'/'05%'; the words in brackets read ten and fifteen percent).

rules.statute: Proc. 1395/2025 art. 52 (2) (Schedule D tax collected from 7 August 2025, art. 4 (2)) (a): 10 %
Proc. 1395/2025 art. 52 (2) (Schedule D tax collected from 7 August 2025, art. 4 (2)) (b): 15 %
Proc. 1395/2025 art. 52 (2) (Schedule D tax collected from 7 August 2025, art. 4 (2)) (c): 10 %
Proc. 979/2016 art. 51 (2) (c): management or technical service fee 15 % (to 6 August 2025)
Proc. 1395/2025 art. 52 (2) (Schedule D tax collected from 7 August 2025, art. 4 (2)) (d): management or technical fee 15 %

notes: only management/technical fees are taxed among service payments (other services by non-residents without a PE are outside art. 51)

twentieth pass (year in force): split at 7 August 2025 (Proclamation 1395/2025 art. 4 (2): 'The tax to be collected on schedule D income and the withholding tax collected on transactions ... shall become effective as of August 7, 2025'): a payment dated to 6 August bears the Proclamation 979/2016 rates, from 7 August the 1395/2025 rates; an undated royalty or dividend is not computed (grade C), undated interest and fees bear the unchanged 10 % / 15 %
unsupported: undated royalty and dividend payments (the rate changed on 7 August 2025): grade C
insurance premiums (5 -> 15 %): not a payment kind
wht.change: Proclamation No. 1395/2025 art. 4 (2): royalty 5 -> 10 %, dividend 10 -> 15 % from 7 August 2025
